svg.title: ConfMix perturbs each sample in proportion to its difficulty
svg.desc: Two scatter panels of a two-class problem. On the left, the static features, with each point's opacity showing how confidently it is classified; the two class clouds overlap in the middle. On the right, the same points after ConfMix, with short lines showing how far each moved: confidently classified points have barely shifted while the ambiguous ones in the overlap region have been pulled well across toward the opposite class mean, and the reported class separation has fallen.
svg.text: ConfMix moves each point toward the other class, by exactly how hard it already was
Opacity is the confidence p_n. Equation 7 mixes each point toward the mean of the
other class by (1 − p_n), so confident points barely move and ambiguous ones are dragged across.
